task.text:
[0] The survival of transgenic animals a with increased catalase expression in peroxisomes (PCAT) was analyzed. Figure 2D, PCAT-SOD-control, PCAT+SOD-experiment, p=0.013

[1] The survival of transgenic animals with increased catalase expression in peroxisomes (PCAT) was analyzed. Figure 2D, PCAT-SOD-control, PCAT+SOD+ experiment, p=0.0001

[2] As compared to diploid controls, transgenic flies carrying three copies of each of these genes exhibited as much as a one-third extension of life-span, a longer mortality rate doubling time, a lower amount of protein oxidative damage, and a delayed loss in physical performance.

[3] P=0.0164, flies line FLP1;CAT2A2;SOD3A1 in the long-lived genetic background were used.

[4] P=0.0548, flies line FLP1;CAT2A2;SOD3A1 in the long-lived background were used.

[5] P=0.4354, flies line FLP1;CAT2B2;SOD3A1 in the long-lived genetic background were used.

[6] P<0.0001, flies line FLP1;CAT2B2;SOD3A1 in the long-lived genetic background were used.

[7] P<0.0001, flies line FLP1;CAT2B12;SOD3A1 in the long-lived genetic background were used.

[8] P=0.0132, flies line FLP1;CAT2B12;SOD3A1 in the long-lived genetic background were used.

[9] P<0.0001, flies line FLP1;CAT2A2;SOD3B2 in the long-lived genetic background were used.

Each numbered passage describes one lifespan experiment. For each, report three things using ONLY that passage:
  organism: the model organism studied, one lowercase word
  direction: exactly one of 'increases lifespan', 'decreases lifespan', or 'no change'
  method: how the gene was altered, e.g. gene knockout, overexpression, mutation, knockdown

Output one block per passage, in order, formatted exactly:
[0]
organism: ...
direction: ...
method: ...

Nothing else. If a passage does not state something, write 'unstated'.
